hype.label: short history, perpetual-index proxy, no verdict; levels from the index through Saturday (d0 - 1), §6.1
hype.note: HYPE: about 17 months of Binance perpetual data and 2 months of Binance spot. Its only deep-wick day (2025-10-10) came 13 days before Robinhood listed it. HYPE is a venue token: its value depends on Hyperliquid's volume and solvency, a risk no price history here can measure (FTT, the token of FTX, fell 97.6%). Not tradable on Robinhood for New York residents.
